name: Screen Recorder
summary: Record your screen from the island: countdown, REC timer with Pause and Stop, phone sound or mic, then Play or Share.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.reason: Only if you choose a sound option: records the microphone or the phone's own sound

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.reason: Shows the recording notification Android requires, with Pause and Stop

privacy: Videos are saved on your phone (Movies › Dynamic Island) and never uploaded. The module has no internet permission.
